$comment: Pricing module (data-model §3.9; D-010, REQ-PRICE-003/020; TASK-080): pricing_config_versions, the versioned GLOBAL configuration that quotes and bookings record. GLOBAL: no org_id and no RLS. Grants (prisma/sql/grants.manifest; data-model §4.4): SELECT only for platform_app; the reference seed as platform_migrator, the owner, is the single writer (insert-only dataset, §9.1), like reference_dataset_versions. runtimeReadOnly makes validateGrants refuse any write line for it and keeps it out of the C15 standard-columns guard scope (no stdColumns flag: no runtime writer). The rule tables (margin_rules, surcharge_rules, cover_terms, discounts) join this manifest with US-152.
